title: Revit governed phase and phase-filter display
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit views use the governed project phase and phase-filter basis for their declared purpose without undocumented local drift or reliance on source example phase names as enterprise authority.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit scope contains views for which phase state or phase-filter display is material to documentation, coordination, review, or export.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested scope contains no view whose intended use depends on phase state or phase-filter behavior.

required_evidence: inventory of applicable Revit views and declared purposes
governed project phase configuration or approved phase mapping
observed View Phase and Phase Filter values
expected phase-display intent for applicable views
approved exception trace where a view departs from the governed basis

result_logic.pass: Every applicable view uses the governed phase and phase-filter basis for its purpose, or has an approved traceable exception, and the resulting display matches the declared project phase intent.
result_logic.fail: An applicable view uses an ungoverned phase or phase-filter state, has undocumented local phase drift, or produces phase graphics inconsistent with the declared view purpose when a governed expected state is available.
result_logic.not_applicable: No view in the tested scope depends on phase state or phase-filter behavior.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project phase configuration, expected phase-display intent, or required mapping is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Round 005 ATS verifies phase/view alignment without making source example phase names or filter combinations canonical.
